About the Role: If you are passionate about understanding shopper behavior and turning insights into business growth, this role offers the opportunity to make a real impact on Ferrero’s Beverage & Chilled categories. As a Shopper Marketing Manager , you will drive category growth by analyzing shopper trends, market dynamics, and category performance. Working closely with Marketing, Sales, and Customer Marketing teams, you will transform insights into strategies that strengthen our brands and create value for both shoppers and customers. Main Responsibilities: You will identify growth opportunities by analyzing shopper behaviors, consumption trends, and market evolution across channels and store formats. You will develop business recommendations to support innovation, category expansion, and product launches, while contributing to sales forecasting and performance reviews. You will work closely with Marketing, Sales, and Customer Marketing teams to define category growth strategies, support assortment and innovation plans, and deliver Category Management projects with key customers. You will also collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment and successful execution of strategic priorities. About You: You bring a Master’s degree in Economics, Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field, along with some years of experience in Marketing, Trade & Shopper Marketing, Customer Management, or Shopper Insights roles, ideally within the FMCG industry. You bring a strong understanding of shopper behaviors and category dynamics, combined with solid analytical skills and experience working with Nielsen, IRI, and consumer research data. Your ability to turn insights into actions helps drive business growth and stronger customer engagement. You are comfortable working with digital tools and business applications, including advanced Excel and the Microsoft Office suite, and you communicate fluently in Italian and English. You bring curiosity, creativity, proactivity, and adaptability, together with a collaborative mindset and the ability to build effective relationships across teams. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape the future of our Beverage & Chilled categories. If you are looking for a dynamic environment where you can influence business decisions and drive category growth, apply now and become part of our journey. What We Offer: The role is classified at Level Quadro 1S under the National Collective Agreement for the Food Industry (CCNL Industria Alimentare). The guaranteed minimum base annual gross salary established by the CCNL for the applicable level is € 50.083. The compensation package also includes an annual variable component with a target of up to 10% of base salary. The overall compensation will be determined based on the experience, skills, and qualifications of the selected candidate. Careers with caring built in - discover our benefits here. About Ferrero: Ferrero began its journey in the small town of Alba in Piedmont, Italy, in 1946. Today, it is one of the world’s largest sweet-packaged food companies, with many iconic brands sold in countries all over the world. Find out more about Ferrero at ferrero.com. DE&I at Ferrero: Ferrero is committed to building a diverse and inclusive culture in which all employees feel welcomed and appreciated and have the same opportunities. We believe all our people are equally talented in their own way. In nurturing the curiosity and natural abilities of our employees, we provide them, generation after generation, the means to succeed personally and professionally, enabling them to craft their journey at Ferrero. The diversity of our talents is what makes our work environment multicultural, innovative, and highly rewarding. Find out more here. Job Description Supports business growth through market research, lead generation, and opportunity identification. Analyzes market trends, customer segments, and competitive insights to develop actionable recommendations, identify high-potential accounts, and support go-to-market initiatives. Collaborates with sales and cross-functional teams to generate, qualify, track, and convert leads while maintaining dashboards and reporting to monitor pipeline performance and business outcomes. How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn Contributes to our enterprise segment sales pipeline growth by transforming market intelligence into actionable recommendations, strategic account pursuits, and targeted business development initiatives. Supports lead-generation and go-to-market initiatives through market mapping, whitespace analysis, heat-maps generation, account prioritization, opportunity identification, and target market assessments. Conducts prospecting and outreach activities with prospective customers, partners, and industry stakeholders to qualify leads and uncover new business opportunities. Collaborates with regional sales teams, growth leaders, partner organizations, and cross-functional stakeholders to align market insights with commercial priorities and pipeline development objectives. Supports regional events, industry conferences, customer engagements, and partner forums by identifying opportunities, generating leads, and ensuring timely qualification and follow-up of prospects. Researches, identifies, and maintains internal and external lead-generation sources, including industry reports, market intelligence platforms, public tender databases, analyst research, news sources, and third-party data providers. Develops actionable market intelligence by analyzing market trends, competitive dynamics, customer insights, and business performance data to identify growth opportunities and support strategic business decisions. Maintains and enhances lead-management dashboards, tracking tools, and reporting mechanisms, providing visibility into lead conversion, pipeline health, and business outcomes. Tracks, measures, and reports on lead-generation performance, campaign effectiveness, and pipeline development metrics, recommending actions to improve conversion rates and business impact. Key Skills And Experience Bachelor's degree in business, Marketing, Economics, Engineering, Data Analytics, or a related field; MBA is a plus. 5–8 years of experience in market intelligence, business development, sales operations, strategy, consulting, or related commercial functions. Proven experience conducting market research, competitive analysis, account prioritization, and opportunity identification. Demonstrated ability to translate market insights into actionable business recommendations and growth strategies. Experience leveraging industry databases, analyst research, market intelligence platforms, CRM systems, and external data sources. Strong analytical skills with proficiency in Excel, Power BI, Tableau, or similar analytics tools. Experience supporting lead generation, pipeline development, and go-to-market initiatives. Strong executive communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders across multiple organizational levels. Experience working with geographically distributed sales, marketing, and business teams. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment while maintaining attention to detail. Telecommunications, networking, enterprise technology, or B2B technology industry experience. Experience with sales pipeline analysis, whitespace analysis, territory planning, or account-based growth strategies. Familiarity with Salesforce, Dynamics CRM, or equivalent sales platforms. Salva Segnala offerta di lavoro We are Reckitt Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose. Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege. Marketing Marketing is at the heart of Reckitt. We pride ourselves on our unique way of driving growth for some of the world's most loved and trusted health, hygiene and nutrition brands. Our purpose and fight are what motivates us to design and deliver distinctive communications throughout our consumer funnel, so that we deliver category growth as well as a positive impact on society. With extensive media and digital teams embedded throughout the organisation, we measure both our business and our societal impact. Our global teams lead on our overarching brand strategy, brand guardianship and innovation pipeline in close partnership with R&D. Leaving our local marketing teams to deliver on our regional goals in partnership with our Sales teams.With the scale of our 2500 marketing community - alongside our leading-edge Marketing Academy - your opportunities to grow and upskill will be extensive. About The Role As Professional Marketing Manager, you will drive Healthcare Professional (HCP) activation excellence through the localisation and implementation of multi-channel engagement toolkits designed to build trust, confidence and recommendation of our self-care brands among HCPs, while measuring and reporting their impact on business performance. Working as part of the IMEX Professional Marketing team, you will contribute to the execution of HCP engagement strategies and success models across multiple brands and HCP audiences. You will be responsible for adapting global toolkits to local market needs and ensuring their effective in-market activation across a range of communication channels, supplementing them with additional local content where required. In close collaboration with Regulatory and other cross-functional stakeholders, you will ensure all HCP-facing materials successfully complete local approval processes prior to deployment. You will also track campaign reach, engagement and effectiveness, generating insights to evaluate impact and support the continuous optimisation of HCP activation initiatives. Your responsibilities Adapt and localise global HCP communication toolkits to meet local market needs, leveraging the Global Success Model (GSM), customer insights, brand science and healthcare ecosystem knowledge to drive awareness, advocacy and category leadership. Gather and translate local HCP insights into impactful communication strategies and engagement initiatives across brands and target audiences. Lead cross-functional collaboration with Global and Local Professional Marketing, Regulatory, Medical, Sales and agency partners to ensure compliant and effective HCP activation across channels. Manage external agencies in the development and delivery of localised HCP content, educational initiatives and engagement materials based on global assets. Support the execution of HCP engagement strategies through collaboration with professional organisations and Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), in alignment with regulatory and company requirements. Develop and optimise HCP go-to-market plans for ongoing engagement activities and product launches, while monitoring performance and identifying opportunities for improvement. Drive the deployment of HCP toolkits to sales and detailing teams and represent the company at key HCP congresses, conferences and professional events, demonstrating strong Professional Marketing capabilities across insights, content, innovation, collaboration and commercial execution. The experience we're looking for Bachelor's degree in Science, Healthcare, Marketing, Communications, Business or a related field, with strong experience in HCP engagement and healthcare communications. Minimum 5 years' experience in pharmaceutical, healthcare or consumer health industries across Professional Marketing, Medical Marketing, HCP Communications, Sales or Detailing roles. Strong understanding of the local healthcare ecosystem, HCP landscape and stakeholder dynamics, with experience developing communication strategies and content for HCP audiences. Experience in developing and implementing multi-channel HCP engagement programmes, including educational materials, communication assets and training content. Proven ability to manage cross-functional collaboration and build effective relationships with both internal and external stakeholders. Strong analytical, organisational and project management skills, with the ability to interpret data, generate insights and translate complex information into clear, actionable plans. Fluent in English and Italian, with excellent written and verbal communication skills. This range is determined in accordance with the applicable collective bargaining agreement and is based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including qualifications, professional experience, competencies, and responsibilities associated with the role. The definition and application of these criteria are carried out in accordance with the company’s internal remuneration policies and are subject to review and validation by the competent HR function. The company guarantees equal opportunities in access, treatment, and professional development, in compliance with applicable legislation. Descrizione dell'azienda EDR Fittings Srl è un’azienda leader sul mercato europeo, con oltre 25 anni di esperienza nella produzione e fornitura di componenti meccanici industriali personalizzati tramite investment casting, stampaggio a caldo, pressofusione e lavorazioni CNC di alta qualità. L’impresa è partner di riferimento per importanti realtà italiane ed europee nei settori automotive, industriale, edilizio, food & beverage e farmaceutico. Numerose attività di audit presso stabilimenti asiatici hanno consentito di garantire prodotti di qualità elevata a costi altamente competitivi. La gestione della qualità è assicurata dalla certificazione ISO 9001 DNV e dalla certificazione ambientale EPD sul processo di investment casting, offrendo un contesto strutturato e orientato all’eccellenza. Descrizione del ruolo Responsabile marketing sarà inserito nel team con sede di lavoro a Genova, in un ruolo full time e svolto interamente on-site. La persona selezionata avrà il compito di definire e implementare le strategie di marketing per i diversi segmenti industriali serviti dall’azienda, coordinando campagne, iniziative promozionali e attività di comunicazione. Nella quotidianità si occuperà di analizzare i mercati di riferimento, monitorare la concorrenza e identificare nuove opportunità commerciali, collaborando strettamente con l’area vendite e con la direzione. Sarà inoltre responsabile della gestione dell’immagine aziendale, dei canali digitali, dei materiali di marketing e del supporto alle attività di public relations e partecipazione a fiere ed eventi di settore. E inoltre necessaria la conoscenza della gestione CRM per implementazione di quella esistente. Qualifiche Il/La candidato/a dovrebbe possedere solide competenze in market planning e market research, per l’analisi dei mercati e la definizione delle strategie. È richiesta esperienza in marketing management, con capacità di pianificare e coordinare campagne e iniziative di comunicazione integrate. Sono importanti competenze in sales e public relations, per collaborare con il team commerciale e gestire in modo efficace la relazione con clienti e partner. Titolo di studio in marketing, comunicazione, economia o disciplina affine, buona conoscenza dell’inglese scritto e parlato e dimestichezza con strumenti digitali e di marketing online. Completano il profilo capacità analitiche, orientamento ai risultati, attitudine al lavoro di squadra, autonomia organizzativa e predisposizione alla collaborazione con funzioni tecniche e commerciali.
